title: Semantic configuration comparison and visual diff
summary: Implemented interpreted design comparison with canvas overlays and precise report highlighting.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Created logical-canvas diff tooling for newer NoC designs.
Built configuration comparison across instances, interfaces, connections, attributes, routes and source YAML, using two isolated Configuration Engine sessions.
Added canvas overlays and HTML reports with precise changed-text highlighting.
